title: Finite-$N$ Operator Algebras and the Hilbert Space of Bilocal Holography
summary: We give an operator-algebraic and representation-theoretic description of the Hilbert spaces of finite-$N$ bilocal holography. This work is a sequel to the finite-$N$ Hilbert space construction of arXiv:2602.20788 [hep-th]. The central result is the establishment of an invariant dual-pair operator algebra: before imposing the singlet constraint the Fock space carries commuting actions of the color group and of a bilocal Lie algebra, while the projection to the singlet sector selects a single irreducible representation of the invariant Lie algebra, which we call a master algebra.
